source: ClassPad.net Math - exact fx-880BTG PLUS, observed 2026-11-20 through visible keys and LCD SVG; saved directly to project.
notes: All expected pixels/status indicators were observed on the exact fx-880BTG PLUS in ClassPad, 20 November 2026. JSON saved directly into this project. 27 raw observations, 25 full LCD/status acceptances, 2 referenceOnly numerical-format cases. No pixel masks.

Added observed 6x22 small tall-parenthesis glyphs from math-tall-exp-paren-fraction-result, then stretched them with fixed caps for other heights. Full screens validate small fraction/root parentheses, two nested pairs, sine with a fraction inside an exponent, and normal/function parentheses.

The same bracket-pair layout now wraps a log-base argument, including fractions and radicals. Cursor markers rise with a power after tall parentheses. A complex log base aligns its top to the ordinary small-font base band; verified for fraction 1/2, sqrt(2), and a fraction base inside an exponent.
Observed log base 1/2 of 8 gives -3 and log base sqrt(2) of 2 gives 2. Numeric expectations are native observations, not mathematical replacements.

Two exact-log holdouts preserve full native pixels/statuses/keys: 2^(log2(1/8)) shows 1/8, and log2(sqrt(2)) shows 1/2. The simulator has 0.125 and 0.5 respectively. Their preceding input screens are accepted separately; this does not replace the result expectations.

2026-11-20 beta.80: both exact-log result holdouts reactivated with unchanged raw keys/pixels/statuses. General rational logarithm proof handles positive rational/square-root operands, including exponent context; no per-expression calibration.
